info.description: Security API pour la plateforme Orchid WebShield.
info.title: Orchid WebShield P3 API

get.description: Lists connectors for the administrator's tenant. Secrets and hashes are never returned.

post.description: Creates a tenant-scoped connector. The plaintext credential is returned only once.
Disables a connector and records its revocation timestamp.
Replaces the connector key ID and secret. The new plaintext credential is returned once.

get.description: Lists the retest history for a finding belonging to the authenticated tenant.
Lists retest results belonging to the authenticated tenant. Supports finding_id, remediation_id, and status filters.

post.description: Records whether a remediation was successful, unsuccessful, or inconclusive. The tenant and performer are derived from the authenticated identity.

get.description: Retrieves a retest result belonging to the authenticated tenant.
Returns paginated assets belonging to the authenticated tenant

post.description: Registers an asset and its authorization scope in the administrator's tenant

get.description: Retrieves one asset by its public asset ID

put.description: Updates an asset without changing its tenant or public asset ID

delete.description: Deletes an asset from the authenticated tenant when it is not referenced by findings

post.description: Authenticates a user and returns a JWT token
Allows a tenant administrator to create an analyst account

get.description: Returns paginated security events belonging to the authenticated user's tenant

post.description: Receives security events from an authenticated connector

get.description: Returns an event by its public event ID, restricted to the authenticated user's tenant

parameters.description: Return records with a smaller database ID
parameters.name: before_id

get.description: Returns paginated incidents belonging to the authenticated tenant

post.description: Receives an incident and stores it in the authenticated tenant

get.description: Returns an incident by its public incident ID
Lists remediation tasks belonging to the authenticated user's organization.

post.description: Creates a remediation task linked to an existing finding.

patch.description: Administrators can update all fields. Responders can update description and status on tasks assigned to them.
